messages:
aisha: Quick draft of the run-of-show and a tiny rehearsal checklist — can people skim and call out blockers?

aisha: high level: 30m talk, 10m demo, 15m panel Qs, 5m CTA. aiming for 50 mins total (inc transitions).

chris: looks good. can we tighten the demo to 8m and use 2m for buffer? helps if infra flaps.

maya: +1 on buffer. also need a fallback demo image/video in case live inference spikes. I can prep a recorded run.

devon: to make the live demo stable: use the dedicated staging endpoint (staging-dedicated.redwood.ai) and pin model to v1.2-quant. run load test at 2x expected qps.

aisha: @devon can you drop the exact load test command we should run?

devon: sure — quick script:```bash
ab -n 200 -c 20 https://staging-dedicated.redwood.ai/demo-endpoint
```

samir: note on recording: we'll capture the presenter screen + system audio. captions team needs the final slide deck by EOD Tue. also recommend we have a 1-min pre-roll clip for the audience while we patch any small infra issues.

maya: I'll make the pre-roll and a short recorded fallback of the demo (30s trimmed). where should I upload?

chris: upload to the marketing drive -> /webinars/assets/rehearsal_fallbacks. I'll make a folder for this speaker.

aisha: onboarding checklist for speakers: 1) join 30m early for mic check, 2) share deck v1.3, 3) confirm demo creds, 4) acknowledge fallback plan.

samir: can we add captioning step: run auto-caption on final recording and file SRT in assets.

aisha: yes, add that. also tagging: please react with :white_check_mark: once your item is done so we can close the checklist quickly.

ops-bot: Reminder: Rehearsal scheduled Thu 10:00 AM PT — meeting link https://zoom.us/j/999999999 (auto-created by ops-bot)

chris: small timing note for the run-of-show: start with 2-min intro, 8-min product narrative, 8-min tech deep-dive, 8-min demo, 8-min customer panel, 6-min Q&A/CTA. that keeps total ~40-45 min plus buffers.

maya: +1. also, let's call out who does the handoff after demo — is that me or @samir?

aisha: handoff: maya does immediate post-demo remarks, then samir moderates panel. I'll add names next to each bullet in the doc.

devon: one more infra note: set env var `REDWOOD_DEMO_MODE=recorded_fallback` on the staging endpoint to make replay deterministic for recordings.

samir: perfect. I'll confirm recording & caption team availability Wed morning.

aisha: thanks all — @chris @maya @devon pls react :white_check_mark: when you've uploaded/ran your items. I'll consolidate the final run-of-show and post it here by EOD.

chris: ✅

maya: ✅ (uploading fallback now)

devon: ✅ load test complete, no issues at 2x qps

aisha: great — closing out. final doc link will be in the thread when ready.
